daily_quests.title: ASX 200 Volatility Ranking with Window Functions
daily_quests.description: Using ASX 200 historical price data, calculate the 30-day rolling standard deviation of daily returns for each stock using window functions. Rank stocks by volatility within each month using ROW_NUMBER(). Identify the top 5 most volatile stocks in the most recent month. Expected output: columns for stock ticker, month, volatility rank, 30-day std dev, and closing price. Use a CTE to calculate daily returns (percentage change from previous day) before computing rolling statistics.

daily_quests.title: NSW Road Crash Data Cleaning and Feature Engineering
daily_quests.description: Download NSW Road Crash data and clean it systematically: handle missing values in Crash Severity and Weather Condition columns (document your strategy), standardise date formats, remove duplicate records based on crash ID, and create new features including time-of-day categories (early morning 00-06, morning 06-12, afternoon 12-18, evening 18-24) and day-of-week. Output a cleaned CSV with all original columns plus new engineered features. Document any rows removed and reasoning in comments.

daily_quests.title: Australian Wine Production ETL Pipeline
daily_quests.description: Build a mini ETL pipeline: (1) Use Python/pandas to fetch or load Australian wine production statistics by region and variety, clean column names (remove spaces, standardise case), handle any missing production volumes by forward-filling or regional averages, and export to a staging CSV. (2) Create a SQL schema with tables for regions, wine varieties, and production records. (3) Write a Python script to load the cleaned CSV into SQLite or PostgreSQL. (4) Write a SQL query using window functions to calculate year-over-year production growth per region and identify which regions increased production most significantly. Expected deliverables: cleaned CSV, SQL schema DDL, Python loader script, and analytical query results showing top growth regions.
